newsitem.title: USA: Dick Morris' wife wants divorce, report says.
newsitem.headline: Dick Morris' wife wants divorce, report says.

text.p: The wife of Dick Morris, President Clinton's former top political advisor who quit after a sex scandal, has decided to end her marriage, the New York Daily News said Sunday.
In an exclusive interview with the tabloid, Eileen McGann, married to Morris for 20 years, said she made up her mind when she was in California last week.

"It had been one crisis after another and I finally had a chance to think," she told the News. "I had really hoped and believed that as time went by this would disappear as a public issue and become a private issue between Dick and me, but that didn't turn out to be true. I realised it would never go away."

Morris' wife said her world became upended after a supermarket tabloid reported last August that her husband had an affair with a $200-an-hour call girl, Sherry Rowlands, who boasted that Morris let her listen to phone calls with Clinton.
McGann, 48, a lawyer, told the News she felt she had lost her privacy completely when a second scandal broke and she learned that her husband had a daughter by a woman in Texas.
Morris, 48, resigned as a Clinton strategist after reports of his affair with the hooker surfaced during the Democratic National Convention in August.
